sentences.text:
Shri Aakash Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Santosh Yadav - Govt. Advocate for respondent State.

Order 
This is second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/ Crime No.478/2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Sidhi for the offences punishable under Sections 379/420/467/ 468/ 471/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 23.10.2024 in M.Cr.C No. 42802/2024.
2.
The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
After the dismissal of previous application vide order dated 23.10.2024 in M.Cr.C No. 42802/2024, charge-sheet in the matter has been filed.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1171 2 MCRC-51114-2024 Co-accused Shailesh Singh has also been enlarged on bail vide order dated 22nd August, 2024 in M.Cr.C No. 32611/2024.
There is allegation against the applicant that he was involved in transportation of wood log without there being any valid documents which are required to be issued by the competent authority.
It is stated by the counsel that challan in the matter has been filed, therefore, applicant is no more required to custodial interrogation.
Hence, the applicant who is suffering incarceration since 30.6.2024 deserves to be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.
On perusal of case diary, it reflects that the challan in the case has been filed.
Co accused Shailesh Singh @ Shailendra Singh @ Amit Kumar Singh has already been enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 30.6.2024.

6. Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation against the applicant, the fact that his past record is unblemished and period of custody of the applicant, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1171 3 MCRC-51114-2024
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant Aman Singh shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
